text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, off to Paris!! Starting 
today, our days abroad begin!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the long trip, Trainer! Our 
overseas expedition is finally underway!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Training during the overseas campaign 
will switch to a dedicated routine, 
different from your time at Tracen 
Academy."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Since we'll be away from the academy, we 
won't be having the SS Matches or 
interacting with the other Umamusume like 
before, but...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, training on-site should 
greatly help in building the foundation to 
adapt to overseas racing!"
choice_data_list:
I'll train thoroughly with specialized 
workouts!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us prepare thoroughly to overcome 
our challenges♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Also, don't forget that <chrname> is registered 
for a GII race before the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"During the Classic Year, the Prix Niel 
will be the designated race."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In the Senior Class, the Prix Foy will be 
the targeted race.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It will be held in "early September," so 
please make sure to keep your schedule 
open.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And once September ends, the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe season will be upon us in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The race to determine the world's best 
will be held at ParisLongchamp Racecourse 
in early October.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...I will also be cheering for you from 
the stands alongside the Chairwoman on the 
day of the race.
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best to live up to everyone's 
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, I pray that these 'three 
and a half months' leading up to the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe will be truly 
fruitful days♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—And so, please let me bear witness to 
your victory at the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe!
